comment: His class is not particularly hard, but he isn't the best teacher. If you can self-teach with the textbook his class will be easy. He gives few grades, and the homework is not challenging or long. Lectures can be boring but not the worst, just understand it will take time out of class to get an A. There are better econ teachers but also worse.

I genuinely don't know how he is a teacher here. His lectures suck and he just yaps and only after we all as a class told him to make slides did he start making them (they're not even that helpful). Exams are open-ended questions, no MC, sometimes asks for stuff he very briefly mentioned, and also want very specific answers. Classes not engaging
